meta.title: {hotel} — hotel
meta.description: Linen, chemistry and inventory management for {hotel}

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in for all hotel staff
login.hint: Maids land in the mobile “My housekeeping” workspace. Administrators and managers land in the control panel.
login.invalid: Invalid login or password. Check your keyboard layout and Caps Lock.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: General interface preferences. Hiding dates does not affect calculations.
settings.showDatesHint: When disabled, “Date” columns are hidden in stock, documents and reports. Document and receipt dates are still stored and used in calculations.
settings.currencyHint: One currency for the whole installation. No conversion is performed.
settings.currencyLocked: Currency is locked: operations already exist. Currency changes are disabled.
settings.currencyConfirm: The currency will change for the whole installation. No conversion is performed; existing numbers stay the same.
settings.operationsLock: Currency can only be changed before the first operation.
settings.integrationCurrencyGuard: 1C integration is available only when the accounting currency is RUB. Change the currency before the first operation or disable the integration.

errors.currencyLocked: Currency cannot be changed after the first operation

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.empty: No operations yet — the journal is empty.

rooms.intro: List, add and filter rooms. Room types are editable and used for minimum stock rules.
rooms.title: Rooms and room types
rooms.viewOnly: View only: creating, editing and deleting rooms is available to administrators.
rooms.deleteConfirm: Delete room {number}? Only rooms without history can be deleted.

branding.hint1: PNG with transparency, up to 1600 px on the longest side (resized automatically). JPEG/WebP are converted to PNG.
branding.accentHint: Buttons, active menu items, links and focus. For white text, contrast must be ≥ 4.5:1.
branding.title: Appearance: logo, color, details
branding.browserNoImage: The browser does not support image processing
branding.fileTooLarge: Source file is larger than 10 MB
branding.compressedTooLarge: Compressed PNG is larger than 2 MB — choose a simpler image
branding.tooLight: Color is too light for white text — choose a darker one

catalog.intro: Price and notes are set here; stock quantity is read-only and is entered when adding to the warehouse.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.title: Item catalog
catalog.invalid: Enter a name, category and valid price
catalog.tableCaption: Item catalog: name, category, price, stock and note

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.intro: Stock by item, catalog price and last receipt date.

operations.errorReason: Write-off reason is required: select one or enter your own
operations.writeoffIntro: A reason is required: a catalog item or free text. Write-off is irreversible; corrections require a new operation.
operations.returnIntro: Return reduces room stock and increases warehouse stock.
operations.errorLines: Add at least one item with a whole quantity greater than zero
operations.receiveIntro: Receiving items increases warehouse stock in one transaction.
operations.reasonPlaceholder: Free-text reason (required if no item is selected)
operations.distributeIntro: Writes off warehouse stock and adds it to the room. Distribution above stock is rejected.

warehouseAdd.errorQty: Quantity must be a whole number greater than zero
warehouseAdd.title: Add to warehouse from catalog
warehouseAdd.errorItem: Select an item from the catalog

audit.draftHint: If a draft already exists for the room, it will open.
audit.author: Author
audit.intro: Compare actual counts with the system. Any discrepancy creates a room stock adjustment. Photos are optional.
audit.title: Room inventory counts

cleaning.title: Housekeeping
cleaning.intro: Cleaning tasks, room statuses and maid performance report. Checklists are out of scope for this stage.

maids.noPeriod: No tasks in the selected period.
maids.title: Maids
maids.intro: Shifts, assigned rooms, daily plan progress and task archive.

checklists.createFirst: Create a template on the left.
checklists.intro: A template is attached to a task; the task cannot be completed until all items are checked and required photos are uploaded.
checklists.title: Cleaning checklists

qr.intro: Labels for rooms and items. Three payload formats (URL, JSON, text) and two image formats (PNG, SVG); the scanner accepts any of them.
qr.savedLabel: Saved label for the selected object
qr.generateHint: Generate a label — image and payload will appear here.
qr.attached: Label is bound to the object
qr.title: QR codes
qr.paramsChanged: Label parameters changed — click Generate and save again.
qr.staleRegen: The saved label is stale — regenerate it.
qr.noSaved: No saved label for this object yet.
qr.checkHint: Check a label on your phone: Home → Scan QR — the scanner accepts URL, JSON and text, as well as manual code entry.

auditSession.appliedLocked: The inventory count is completed; edits are locked. Corrections require a new count.
auditSession.photoPick: Take or choose a photo (JPEG/PNG/WebP, up to 5 MB)
auditSession.author: author {name}
auditSession.applyWarning: Applying creates a stock adjustment; it can only be reversed by a counter-operation.
auditSession.appliedSummary: Inventory completed. Discrepancies: {changed} (surplus {increase}, shortage {decrease}) · difference value {value}.

rolesAdmin.title: Roles and permissions
rolesAdmin.intro: Permissions are checked on the server for every request. Administrator user and role management cannot be removed — protection against self-lockout.

users.loginHint: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore
users.intro: Add maids, assign rooms, change roles and reset passwords.
users.passwordPrompt: Set a new password and confirm the reset.
users.title: Users and roles
users.changePassword: Password change is a separate action.

reportsPage.intro: Stock and movements with prices and values, minimum-stock shortages and items without a price.
reportsPage.author: Author
reportsPage.title: Reports
reportsPage.noPriceEmpty: All active items have a price.
reportsPage.noLow: No shortages — all stock is at or above the minimum.

integration.contractWarning: The 1C contract (path, JSON fields, webhook availability) is not confirmed by public documentation. Verify it on a 1C test environment before enabling.
integration.tokenCreated: New webhook token created. Copy it to 1C.
integration.title: 1C settings
integration.roomStatusIntro: The incoming webhook updates room status without creating a task. App changes (cleaning, manual status) go to 1C through a retrying queue. The exact 1C contract is confirmed per release.
integration.intro: Connection, item synchronization and operation queue. The integration can be disabled completely — accounting continues locally.
integration.tokenSetHint: A token is set. A new token replaces the old one.

dashboard.shiftStartHint: Start the day to see your tasks

actions.scanSubtitle: Open a room from a label

errors.quantity: Quantity must be a whole number greater than zero
errors.photoOffline: Photos can be uploaded only when online

taskDetail.offlineHint: Offline: checklist marks and photos are unavailable
taskDetail.commentPlaceholder: For example: minor repair needed, forgotten belongings
taskDetail.noticeDone: Cleaning completed: the room is clean
taskDetail.noticeChecklistComplete: Checklist complete — you can finish the cleaning
taskDetail.errorChecklistOffline: Checklist marks can be set only when online

auditList.title: Inventory count
auditList.offlineStart: An inventory count can only be started online
auditList.startError: Could not start the inventory count

auditSession.offlineHint: Offline: saving and applying will be queued
auditSession.photoCamera: Take a photo with the camera (online only)
auditSession.offlineDraftQueued: No network: the draft has been queued and will be sent automatically
auditSession.offlineApplyQueued: No network: applying is queued and will run when the network is back
auditSession.applyError: Could not apply the inventory count

distribute.title: Distribution
distribute.subtitle: Linen and chemicals from stock to the room
distribute.offlineHint: Offline: the distribution will be queued
distribute.queuedNotice: No network: the distribution is queued and will be sent when the network is back

scan.title: Scan QR
scan.subtitle: A room label opens inventory count or distribution; an item label opens distribution.
scan.cameraError: Camera unavailable. Permission and a secure context (HTTPS or localhost) are required. You can enter the code manually.
